scientific_integrity: General result justified by symbolic normal-form and clausewise extremum proof; rational checker provides finite corroboration only. No independent scientific validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact bound applies only to finite-variable propositional rational-constant non-expansive fuzzy terms; not modal operators or full Lukasiewicz binary operations. Explicit interpolants can be exponentially large. Equivalence to a historical lattice-polynomial elimination result cannot be categorically excluded.
title: Sharp half-grid witnesses for rational non-expansive fuzzy propositional elimination
